text:
Situation: Ampicillin sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current hospital inventory across presentations ranges from 12.6 to 27.6 days on hand. A prior FDA shortage posting for Sandoz Inc. ampicillin sodium injection was marked To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-12-08.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows ampicillin sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The Sandoz Inc. posting was marked To Be Discontinued effective 2025-12-08. OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited - Beta Lactam Division (FEI 3005652193) received an OAI classification on 2015-09-01 and a VAI on 2019-02-14.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. No active shortage exists per FDA. Alternate manufacturers are available but none have placeable plants identified on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue current purchasing from existing contracted suppliers; buyer approves.
2. Qualify Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. as first alternate source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
3. Qualify Civica, Inc. as second alternate source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
4. Qualify Eugia US LLC as third alternate source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
5. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly for status changes; buyer approves.

Not recommended: Do not initiate conservation protocols or formulary changes at this time.
